title: Aftercare Quick Reference for Marlowe & Finch Alterations: Pickup Hold, Remakes and Damage
content:
After the work on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket is finished, the hold, remake and damage figures of the garment's service class apply. The table carries every class.

| Term | Express Hem & Cuff | Standard Alterations | Tailored Suiting | Formal & Evening Wear | Bridal Alterations | Leather & Specialty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after the ready date a garment is held for pickup before it is donated | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Calendar days after the ready date on which an unclaimed-garment reminder is sent | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| What happens to a garment not collected in the hold period | donated to the charity partner | donated to the charity partner | donated to the charity partner | donated to the charity partner | donated to the charity partner | donated to the charity partner |
| Calendar days after the pickup date within which a remake of unsatisfactory work is accepted free of charge | 14 | 14 | 30 | 14 | 14 | 30 |
| Maximum free remakes per ticket | 1 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| Maximum compensation for a garment damaged or lost during alteration (USD) | 250.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2500.00 | 1500.00 |
| Calendar days after the pickup date within which damage must be reported | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Form in which damage compensation is paid | merchandise credit card | merchandise credit card | merchandise credit card | merchandise credit card | merchandise credit card | merchandise credit card |

## Grouped the other way

- **The same in every class:** a 90-day hold, a reminder on day 30, donation to the charity partner, a 7-day damage-report window and settlement on a merchandise credit card.
- **Remake windows:** 30 days in Tailored Suiting and Leather & Specialty, 14 days in the other four classes.
- **Remake counts:** two free remakes in Tailored Suiting and Bridal Alterations, one in the other four classes.
- **Damage caps:** rising from 250.00 USD (Express Hem & Cuff) to 2500.00 USD (Bridal Alterations); Formal & Evening Wear and Leather & Specialty share 1500.00 USD.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Tailored Suiting jacket damaged during alteration and bought for 1200.00 USD is compensated at no more than that class's 1000.00 USD maximum; the same garment value on a Bridal Alterations ticket stays within that class's 2500.00 USD maximum.
